title: Great Routine App with Smart Features
body: If you're looking for a routine app and not a habit app, I can definitely recommend this one. It has a simple design, great colors, and a super smart feature that automatically finds icons for your routines – that's really clever!
author: Rudi177

title: No trial?
body:
Went through the setup process. It even tells you about a notification a couple of days before the trial ends. I went ahead and didn’t catch that I wasn’t provided a trial anyway. 
It is just 10 bucks but this is the sort of stuff I dislike.
Already uninstalled the app.
author: Kenneth Brodersen

title: Best routine app I've used
body:
